pages.text: Consume eligible creatures to collect identities. Tap transform (X) to toggle a disguise. Hold it and choose the identity collection to change your selection. Each entry lists its species ability and binding. Collect a military identity before infiltrating dispatch.

Watch for witnesses: attacks or vehicle theft at a checkpoint can raise the alarm. Break sight around corners or on rooftops. Once unlocked, use your defensive and sensory powers to cover an approach or identify infected targets.
